sentences.text: This is the last lesson of the course.
You have every skill you need.
Today we use them all, in order, the way the exam will ask you to.
The plotting exam is a set of questions, worked on the training chart.
You need seventy percent to pass.
The questions often build on each other, like a real trip.
You plot a departure, lay a course, take bearings, find a fix, work out the current, and compute an arrival time.
So what happens if you get the second question wrong?
It can carry through the next three.
That’s why you keep a scratch sheet with every step written down.
When an answer doesn’t match a choice, you can walk back through your work and find the slip in a minute, instead of starting again.
